title: Better Cake
description: Let's you eat cake from hand and adds other features making cake better.
body: # Make your experience with cake better! Placing the cake to the ground in order to eat it is a bit **lame**. So this plugin let's you **eat it from your hand**. Also if you already placed it, **you can break it and it will drop with remaining slices**! Isn't it much better?. ![Cake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7366ee418516b7b8db1db8dd9be9a718f79fd264.jpeg) In future will add more features making it even better. I want to add reduced fall damage if you fall on cake.
